cocoa

noun
 
/ˈkəʊkəʊ/
 
/ˈkəʊkəʊ/
jump to other results
  1. [uncountable] dark brown powder made from the seeds (called cocoa beans) of a tropical tree

  2. [uncountable] a hot drink made by mixing cocoa powder with milk and/or water and usually sugar
    • a mug of cocoa
    Topics Drinksb2
  3. [countable] a cup of cocoa
    4. compare chocolate, drinking chocolate
    Word Originearly 18th cent. (denoting cacao seed): alteration of cacao.
